name: Motor phase-unbalance alarm interface
summary: Carries the selected unbalance monitoring result into the feeder control system.
description: Carries the selected unbalance monitoring result into the feeder control system. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Phase measurements” at the input and “Unbalance alarm state” at the output. Alarm and trip levels are separately specified.
